item.description: As parameter counts in generative AI models expand exponentially, single-GPU configurations can no longer meet processing demands. item.title: Valleytronics on a single chip
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01975-3 The integration of light-programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuits based on two-dimensional semiconductors has been limited by complex optical readout using bulk optics. Now, a chip integrates a metasurface with a waveguide and on-chip photodetectors to generate, sort, and read out optical valley signals in the near field, all at room temperature.
